benchmark_entry.name: Formalize the FRA value δ·P(0,T₂)·(F−K) and simple forward rate F = (P(0,T₁)/P(0,T₂)−1)/δ
benchmark_entry.description: FRA value is zero exactly when the strike equals the simple forward rate.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.MathFin.FixedIncome.ForwardRate

open MathFin

/-- FRA value is zero exactly when the strike equals the simple forward rate. -/
theorem mf_fra_value_and_fair_rate (T₁ T₂ : ℝ) (P₁ P₂ : ℝ) (hδ : T₂ - T₁ ≠ 0) (K : ℝ)
  (h_pos : P₁ > 0 ∧ P₂ > 0) :
  let δ :=
  MathFin.fra_value_zero_iff_fair T₁ T₂ P₁ P₂ hδ K h_pos
